set.pl: Wyandotte Farm (R. C. Bennett estate), on the S side of Bennett Lake, 1 mi W of Conover on County Trunk K (1951 paper)
pinev: Bennett estate = Wyandotte farm, 1 mi W of Conover on CTH K, on Bennett Lake (News-Review 1951). On 2022 USGS 1 m lidar the ground between the lake's S shore and CTH K is open field, with a few small pits and mounds near 46.0559,-89.2795 that may be farmyard features; buildings do not show on bare-earth lidar, and no 1938 aerial was read.

src: Vilas County News-Review, 4 Oct 1951, p. 1, '$25,000 Bennett Farm Fire' (Newspapers.com 1280950983): barn on the R. C. Bennett estate, the Wyandotte farm, 'one mile west of Conover on County Trunk K'; water drawn from Bennett Lake

set.v: Coin collection said to be worth about $20,000, never found (henhouse jars and trunk money recovered)
